gate: scripts/shared_tools/check_seam_drift.py (ci-standard.yml job seam-drift-gate, needs of quality-gate)

ruling_values.tools-canonical: Tools owns the module; delete the UD copy under src/shared/python (an import shim carrying SEAM_SHIM_MARKER may remain).
ruling_values.ud-canonical: UpstreamDrift authored the module; upstream UD's version to Tools first (Tools #4494), then delete the UD copy. Needs a tools_ledger_row while Tools still carries a copy.
ruling_values.split: The UD package mixes Tools-owned files (delete/shim) with UD-only modules that stay; the gate requires zero overlapping paths once cleaned.
ruling_values.deferred: Could not be decided in <10 minutes; deferred_reason says why and what unblocks it.

status_values.pending-cleanup: Ruling recorded, UD copy still present; the gate only reports.
status_values.n/a: Nothing to clean in UD (Tools-only entry).

todo.note: Replace the vendor/ud-tools submodule + git pin with the ud-tools wheel once Tools publishes one per release.
Rewrite the 152 spelling-only divergences (src.shared.python -> shared.python) in UD instead of carrying them as a fork; they vanish once the UD copies are deleted.
Deferred packages (config, reporting, gui_launcher, __init__.py) need a namespace decision with the Tools ledger owner.

README.md.rationale: Identical copy of Tools' package README. UD copy retired 2026-09-05: every tracked file was byte-identical to the pinned Tools tree, so the vendored fallback returns the same bytes that were deleted.

__init__.py.deferred_reason: Root init cannot be deleted while UD-only packages live in the same namespace; converge on Tools' init plus pkgutil.extend_path once the UD-only packages have a home (Phase 2).

chat_contracts.rationale: 4 identical files; added to UD by #8322 while the shadow guard was disabled. UD copy retired 2026-09-05: every tracked file was byte-identical to the pinned Tools tree, so the vendored fallback returns the same bytes that were deleted.

codemap.rationale: All 6 diverged files are newer in Tools (2026-08-24/25) than UD's 2026-08-01 copy. UD copy retired 2026-09-06: canonical was ahead in all six diverged files and UD held no unique content -- its differing lines were older forms of the same lines. Canonical narrows two blind `except Exception` to `except ImportError`, adds justified noqa annotations, and replaces bare `"git"` subprocess argv with `resolve_trusted_git_executable()` plus a graceful fallback, closing a PATH-hijack weakness UD still carried.

compatibility.py.rationale: Single compatibility shim owned by Tools (issue #7249 path in the child-copy contract). UD copy retired 2026-09-06: the only difference was that canonical splits the TYPE_CHECKING branch so type checkers see explicit UTC/StrEnum imports, which is runtime-equivalent on this repo's 3.11 floor; the canonical 3.10 backport branch is inert here.

config.rationale: UD's config/ is a 15-file UD-authored package (environment.py +13.6 KB, tools_vendor_authority.py, model_registry.py); only __init__.py and environment.py collide with Tools' 2-file config package.
config.deferred_reason: Namespace collision between two unrelated packages; needs a rename on one side (Tools ledger decision), not a delete.
